nom: PÜR Minerals Joystick Exfoliating Deep Pore Clay Cleansing Stick

avis.titre: I have never been so impressed with a product
avis.texte: I am not typically one to write a review but i was so impressed i had to share. I have tried a myriad of clensers claiming the same deep poor cleaning attributes but you buy, use and nothing, just another worthless clenaser on the shelf. My first wash with this my skin actually felt smooth and clean, legitimately clean. After two days i was already seeing a problem area on my chin starting to clear! I have been battling that area for a long time and have never been able ti clear it up. I wish i had taken before and after pictures. Im 37, i do not have acne prone skin, just deeply clogged areas especially on nose and jawline areas from makeup and buildup. My skin hasnt been this clear in ages. The only negative thing i have to say is the size for price. I think i will use it daily for a week to clear up and then just use it every other day or couple days. I love!

it's an okay, easy-to-use exfoliant if you don't mind having GLITTER RESIDUE left all over your face. it was such a struggle to get it all off even with a facial cleanser, have not used it ever again.

This is an excellent find for me. I love the stick idea, because it allows you to use the exact amount. I absolutely love the feel of it while you are massaging it in, its a feeling of it cleaning away all the gunk from your skin. After washing it off, my skin was glowing. It's definitely gentle and gives you just enough to make a great difference but not too much to where it will damage. Buy it! You will love it!

I love using this stick because its fun to apply, but also actually feels like my skin is getting cleaned. I have rough pores and noticed a difference after a few uses. The only down side is that it's not ideal for dry skin types. I still use it though because it does such a great job!
this product has really helped with minimizing unwanted texture on my skin. i also have hyperpigmentation and this has helped even my skin. would recommend for oily skin!!

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: I love every bit of this product, it makes my skin smooth and soft giving it it that youthful look.

I purchased this while it was on sale for 30% off and it still was not worth the price. I used it twice a week and it only lasted about 2 months. I used it sparingly, as well. Genuinely there is almost no product. I do believe it disrupted my skin barrier as well. I wasn't struggling with acne and redness prior to using this but by the time I had finished it my skin was worse off than when I'd started. I wouldn't recommend. It also doesn't feel good or luxe to use it. It doesn't feel cosmetically elegant and doesn't have a nice scent.
the smell is not good and mine broke half way thru using it. I have a picture but no way to attach on mobile device

There are so many great things about this product: 1, it's easy to hold and doesnt dissolve; I would always get really frustrated with exfoliators because it seemed like it would dissolve before it did anything. This one has the packaging so you don't have to touch it too much with your hands and the beads (exfoliators) don't dissolve as soon as they hit water or heat!! 2, feels amazing; the texture is very soft and creamy, but you can still feel the exfoliation 3, you don't need much; I rubbed this on my T zone for about five seconds and then that's all you need. 4, personally, I saw immediate results; I've been out of practice with exfoliating my face because I've been looking for a really nice exfoliator but right after I used this, my skin was so soft and my pores were so much smaller (but again I haven't exfoliated in my face in a while so that might have something to do with it) 5, clean ingredients; i'm a sucker for clean ingredients, especially for stuff that's going on my face

There are so many great things about this product: 1, it's easy to hold and doesnt dissolve; I would always get really frustrated with exfoliators because it seemed like it would dissolve before it did anything. This one has the packaging so you don't have to touch it too much with your hands and the beads (exfoliators) don't dissolve as soon as they hit water or heat!! 2, feels amazing; the texture is very soft and creamy, but you can still feel the exfoliation 3, you don't need much; I rubbed this on my T zone for about five seconds and then that's all you need. 4, personally, I saw immediate results; I've been out of practice with exfoliating my face because I've been looking for a really nice exfoliator but right after I used this, my skin was so soft and my pores were so much smaller (but again I haven't exfoliated in my face in a while so that might have something to do with it) 5, clean ingredients; i'm a sucker for clean ingredients, especially for stuff that's going on my face

Really good at detoxing my pores and leaving my skin very soft and smooth and also balanced. I immediately apply my GET WITH THE GLOW serum and pur moisturizer Tropical C on top. You would think I have on make up and I don't. Thanks PUR
Dead skin and sebum still VERY present after use. Very useless product. Not sure what to do with it.
This really cleard up all of my acne and blackheads. Dont listen to Yuka try all of the skincare from PUR. Amazing results!
Would highly recommend the joystick. It is a gentle exfoliator. My skin feels soft after using it.

Found it in my bathroom. Forgot how to use it, but with it being semi dry hurt so I put more water, and it worked better. I had dryness on my face that was flaky and stuck. So, I used this. It did make my face sting after use, but the surface felt like marble. This morning, my face is smooth. No dryness. There are little flakes by my left eyebrow, but that could be me not doing that area. Very happy with this product.
I got this on sale and didn't know what to expect! Well, I LOVE IT! I'll definitely be buying more!! So easy to use and cleans my pores thoroughly!!
Used it for the first time and it definitely helps alot and is gentle on the skin. Try it out :)

I suffered from acne and pimples and bumps of congestion on my chin everyday because i lean my hands on my chin while working. This is the first product ever to get rid and keep away those congestion bumps, pimples, and acne from all over my face. I have sensitive skin and i use it twice a day. It even removed my make up. The only con is that using the stick everyday. I go through a sitck once a month. So i will be sure to catch sales.
addicted love it got on sale now paying full price bc love it so much 😍

I like the easy application and the exfoliation but I wonder how long this small tube will last. Im using once a day. And how sanitary is it for my skin since youre applying directly to skin. Im on the fence!

I LOVE this exfoliator. It doesnt bave much of a fragrance but the texture feels like ground almonds. Always leaves my face looking nice without making it look or feel like its been scrubbed raw. I have sensitive skin and now this joystick goes everywhere with me.
I'm 49yrs and i truly like this product! It's none abrasive, produces clean, smooth, clear & consistent results. This scrub is my favorite and go to. .

Easy to use and leaves skin feeling GOOD! I typically get clogged pores on my nose, purchased this wonderful stick for that reason too. You just dampen your nose area, rub the stick over it and then massage everything in. It cleans out the gunk and makes pores appear a lot smaller.

I have combination skin. The Pur Joystick hasn't helped prevent breakouts, but my skin does feel softer. It is a great exfoliator. The scent is light and pleasant. It's a lot smaller than I thought it would be, but it is a good product on the whole.

I like the option to use as face mask as well, great exfoliation. Smell is light if any at all. Only down side is the size for price. Just started using if it lasts a while I'd change my about size, we will see
I really like this, it's not painful or overly scratchy. My skin feels soft & clean after using.

A little goes a long way! I love the way it makes my skin feel but I can't use it too much or it can cause a breakout or feel rough. But once a week it's a nice refresh! The only thing I don't like about the packaging is that I can't store it in the shower or it'll stay wet. I keep it on the counter, I just don't use it in the shower like I can my other exfoliants in bottles but not the end of the world. Will probably buy again but not at full price lol
I love it it makes my skin feel really soft after using and cleans my pores after wearing makeup most of the time for work
I absolutely love this! I use twice a week and my skin feels fabulous. None irritating and very gentle
This is a great exfoliator. I like that there's smaller exfoliation pieces to really help remove dead skin cells and it's so easy to use.

I have been using this exfoliator for almost two years now, and I love it! It is very gentle on the skin, leaves the skin feeling soft, and has helped with my ance. I recommend this to someone who has sensitive skin. I just wish there was more product.

I hadn't used this product in a while and then picked it up again in a recent purchase and was reminded again of how much I love it! Easy to use, packable, swipe on problem areas or all over face (avoiding eyes of course), let it sit or wash off immediately. My face feels smoother and does a better job at soaking in my other skincare products. Thanks PUR!

I don't do good with masks and exfoliates bc they NEVER work. So, I got this. I decided to use it as a mask, and left it on for longer than 2-3 mins until it dries. It doesn't get HARD like masks do. If you scratch your face it will come off. Soft to the touch. The grit in it: doesn't have you wondering if your stripping your skin. I didn't massage it in my face, but used it as a mask: applied and left on then rinsed with warm (hot water; bc who has time to make the right temp; I'm not always this lazy), and it came off! What surprised me was it felt soft automatically, but bc I'm used to residue from products I kept trying to wash off. Eventually 3 seconds later, gave up, and dried it. It has a slight sticky feel while drying. After it dried: SOFT and SMOOTH skin. I was SURPRISED. I was like holy mollie: what is this?! Not sure if it did anything for the DEEP PORE, but for dryness and patches: Miracle!

Was recommended by an ulta expert and it was the best decision I've ever made. I usually get very scared to use exfoliators because I always end up having an allergic reaction but not with this one! Left my skin so soft!!! SO WORTH IT!!!!
I am on my second purchase. This little gem is perfect for exfoliating my face in the shower and I keep it there. It's perfect!

I actually asked a Ulta advisor for something to help me with a break out that was constant in the same area that I couldn't seem to rid myself of. Especially with mask being the new norm. So I used it and Voila gone! I use after heavy makeup wear

avis.titre: I am on the fence about this product
avis.texte: I purchased this as a physical exfoliant on the recommendation of the clerk at Ulta. I don't know what I paid for it but you can't roll/twist up the product what you see there on top is what you get. When I used it the product feels gritty like it should for an exfoliant so I gave 5 stars as I believe it will do what it is supposed to do however I will not repurchase this item.

I love this product! I used it 2-3 times per week to maintain a soft silky texture for my face. Twist, rub onto face in key areas, use hands to massage in circular motion. I'm ordering my second stick. Paired with the moisturizer my skin feels amazing! I'm 47 and am mistaken for being in my early 30's all the time. Highly recommend.

been using this 2-3 times a week to help keep my skin soft & it has been great. I tend to have very acne prone skin but this has not irritated my skin at all. My skin is so soft after use & feels good for several days afterwards
This is a great product. It has just the right texture of grit to be able to feel it exfoliating but not rub you raw. It smells great and is convenient to use in the stick form. Love it!

I had thought I knew what soft skin felt like, it wasn't until I tried this I finally had it! The other reviews on here couldn't be more spot on. My biggest issue was makeup looking cakey and I figured it was my pores popping up, and this is helping immensely! The more you use over time the better your skin looks! 10/10!

Great option for physical exfoliation. I really like the stick format, easy to use and not as messy as some other exfoliators. When first twisting the product up to get more, you definitely have to twist hard and get it to pop up--I think maybe it's locked in the original packaging so the stick won't get damaged. So if yours won't initially go up, keep twisting! Otherwise, it's a nice, fine-grain and I like that it's a cleanser and toner all in one so that when you use it, you can skip the other steps in your routine!

I loved this product so much that I went back to Ulta to buy another one! I have not had a facial in over one year due to the pandemic. This product, along with the rest of the PÜR line, has giving me the results that I usually experience after a facial. I'm 44 and enjoying aging naturally. I feel that the PÜR products are made exactly for women my age. Thank you so much!!!
this cleasner is so nice. my face is squeaky clean when done. feels good abd smells good too

This cleanser, exfoliator, toner all in one is the best product for clearing pores that I've tried. Nothing else has ever worked for me. This is my new favorite! It's easy to use and you don't need a lot of product as it foams up and easily spreads.
The first time I used this I fell in LOVE! I love using the roll-up stick! Genius idea making it in a roll-up! Love how it deep cleans my T zone!

It definitely does exfoliate a bit since after I can see blemishes that were forming under the dead layers of skin, but I find the Tula scrubs work an bit better and are less harsh. I am going to continue to use this and see if it makes a difference.
I bought this on a whim and have loved it so far!! I have only used it when my pores look really bad but I want to use it more regularly to see the long term affects!
This feels like fine-grit sandpaper on my skin, but it also seems very cleansing. My skin feels quite smooth afterward. The stick makes it easy to apply.

So first of all, this did exfoliate really well and made my skin feel amazing! But, there was literally only enough product in the bottle for one use. I am not sure if I got a defective tube but it is supposed to roll up like chapstick or deodorant and basically nothing more came up. While I was using it for the first time I got to the plastic at the bottom of the dispenser. I got it while it was on sale but still even at that price it's super overpriced for one use. I was so excited to use it so I'm super bummed about it.
So convenient and cute! Love how it's made in a stick form. Smaller than I thought. But works great

so I was a bit hesitant at buying this because of the price but you didn't have to twist my arm because all the other pur products I've purchased are on point! and this exfoliating cleaners DID NOT disappoint! my skin looks soooooo nice and smooth even right after using it. im hooked!

This product is very convenient and totally mess-free. I have oily, sensitive, and acne prone skin and this product makes my face feel super smooth and gives it a nice glow. I like to use this 2x a week, before face serums and creams. I am happy that this product is a part of my nighttime skin care routine. I hope you enjoy it as much as I do! :)
my face is usually clear. I used this last night and tonight and I have a new blemish. does acne come out first then clear it up? not sure if I should keep using.

avis.titre: I would but this product again
avis.texte: I use in the morning while showering and again at night before bed. This product makes my face feel great. It has also helped with my blemishes. They say will take of those brown spots. We shall see. I will let you know how that works.

avis.titre: I will continue to purchase this product!
avis.texte: Love the mess free way to exfoliate and you leave it on for 2 minutes because it will turn into a mask.
I use this product at night to clear out all of the impurities from the day. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth.
I have used this twice and seen my pores and blackheads already minimizing.
breakout gone... keep in my shower caddy and use once a week as an exfoliator. helped clear my skin and smooth it. definitely recommend
it's easy to use and it removes dead skin without being too harsh on my acne prone skin.

avis.titre: Clears skin but doesn't last long
avis.texte: I use it first before using Aveeno calming foaming cleanser and moisturize with Ponds dry skin moisturizer and Vitamin E lotion
I use this product only at night. Its small and it lasted about 3,mos. My face feels clean and not dry. The granules are fine so it isn't harsh on my skin.
Keep it in my shower to wash my face. It has really help remove dead dry spots

I have suffered from acne for years and have tried hundreds of different products. I am happy to report that my search has ended and this stick is AMAZING! Not only is my skin clear, it has a smooth glow to it that other harsh acne lines don't give. I love using it because it makes my skin feel so clean and soft. I do wish it lasted longer and came in a larger stick though. All in all, 1 completely recommend anyone suffering from acne or dull/dry skin to give this a try, you won't regret it!

I love the Joystick from Pur! It reminds me the microdelivery exfoliating wash from philosophy, but even a tiny bit more gentle while still getting a nice exfoliating grain that you can feel. You don't actually scrub with the stick, just use it to apply the exfoliant and then rub in and physically exfoliate with your hands. You can leave this on for 5 min in the shower as a deep pore mask. It's fantastic! This is my third one! Lasts about 3 months for me with daily/weekly use.

avis.titre: Keep it in the shower and use it all the time!
avis.texte: I cleanse with it every other day in winter and every day in summer. You still need to moisturize, but this leaves my skin clean and fresh!

i bought this because a nice lady at ulta recommended it for sensitive, acne prone skin and i was a bit skeptical because im very much into skincare but have never heard of this one. im shook to the core lmao i used it a few times now and its soooo good! definitely leaves my skin smooth but not dry or irritated and it hasnt caused any breakouts. plus its really convenient to use because its in stick form, less messy than regular exfoliators. 10/10

I bought the joy stick expecting it to exfoliate my skin, and it did just that. It has also helped moisturize my skin and leave a clean feeling after I'm done using it. Before using the joy stick, I use a face wash to help remove makeup and cleanse my face. I apply the joy stick and I remove the exfoliation with a wet clean towel instead of just water. I've used it once a day, every other day, and it's also help close any lingering white heads.
It is so amazing I love how it is cleanser toner and exfoliator!!

I have very dry skin during the winter months, this was the first product that helped me to get rid of the flaky skin on my face! I use this 3 times a week, wet my face, swirl on the scrub stick, and massage gently in a circular motion, then leave it on for 3 minutes as a mask. VIOLA! Smooth skin! Then I moisturize :) Good stuff! REMEMBER scrubs are not for people with sensitive skin! And even if you have 'normal' skin you should still be gentle when using a scrub. Not sure what happened with the other reviewer that 'scrubbed' her face off but...yowch! Go easy gurl!
It cleaned my face, but for the price it doesn't have much product.
I tried this product because it was on sale.. love it! Use it since 2 weeks every day in the shower and my skin feels amazing .. it's soft and it feels extra clean..

avis.titre: I love it! Leave your skin so fresh and clean
avis.texte: I use it every morning, after been applied the serum the night before

avis.titre: BEWARE, IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE SKIN STAY AWAY
avis.texte: My skin is not acne prone I'm just sensitive to many face products with fragrance one of the girls at the PUR counter in Ulta recommended this product due to my allergies, I used it ONE time and I woke up the next morning with a burning face and A TERRIBLE breakout. Have NEVER had such a bad reaction to a product it even caused small fluid filled blisters under my nose. Will have to call the allergist tomorrow, to fix what this product has caused. The photos below (Both are WO/ ANY make-up) show the day before I used this product and the day after I used this product and you can be the judge on this product.
This works well and was good for my combo, acne prone skin. But it did not last long...not enough product for the price. Also, I used my fingers more than the stick so it would last longer.

avis.titre: Best exfoliator I have ever tried....
avis.texte: I live for this exfoliator. Doesn't tear my skin apart, but is very very effective at doing its job. Not to mention there's no chemicals in this brand 😆😆😆 if your reading this you really can't go wrong.

avis.titre: Love the product- wish it wasn't so expensive!
avis.texte: The product works wonderful. It comes in a stick that is easy to apply to your face. It contains tiny grains of (something?) that exfoliate perfectly. They aren't too rough but are effective. It removes makeup and leaves the skin feeling clean and fresh. It seemed to have cleared some acne and evened out my skin tone. I just wish it wasn't so expensive. The stick fits within the palm of your hand and lasted about 5 weeks with once daily use.
A SALES REP INTRODUCED ME TO THIS BRAND WHILE I WAS SHOPPING AND IM SOOOO GLAD SHE DID. I LOVE THE JOYSTICK. ITS SO EASY AND CONVIENENT TO USE! I WILL BE GOING BACK FOR THE FACE MIST AND WASH!!

This product is great. I was at ulta looking for a deep cleaning treatment that would help with clearing pores & reducing a few breakouts & oiliness. This was great. The associate who helped me told me to wet my face rub stick on it lather/exfoliate and leave on for a few minutes & wash off. I immediately saw a difference & I will buy this again and again.

avis.titre: I would buy this as soon as I ran out
avis.texte: I use this product three times a week to exfoliate and my skin has never felt SO good

I was looking for a new exfoliator and one of the sales reps recommended this to me and I do not have enough good things to say about it! It exfoliates w/o being too harsh and you can let it sit on your face for 3 mins. to work as a mask too! I absolutely love it.

Great product! I've used several exfoliating products and this one is great. I have oily,sensitive skin and this one doesn't bother me at all. My skin feels so soft and refreshed after using. I even use on my neck and chest. Only con would be the joystick. It's convenient, but it gets alittle messy. Other than that great product!
Love this!!! Lots of complements on how young I look since I started using this once a day!

I have tried multiple exfoliating products, this by far is the best. I have always had somewhat dry skin and college has sent my acne and oil into full swing. Nothing was working for me until I found this product, I wish I had tried it first! After just one use my skin was smoother, my complexion was more even, less red, not dry or oily and my pores were almost invisible. I bought this item after reading reviews and I will buying this every time I run out. If I could rate higher than 5 stars I would!!
Use every other day to remove dead skin cells and remove impurities. I love it!
I've purchased drugstore to high end exfoliation products and I love this one. Just turn it up and roll on your face! Granule consistency was perfect for effectiveness without being harsh.

this is my new holy grail exfoliator. I have a really hard time finding exfoliators for my dry, sensitive skin. most exfoliators are too harsh for me, but this one is perfect! it gets the job done, makes my skin feel so smooth and fresh, and doesn't irritate my skin at all! will be purchasing this time and time again!
Love this product. I use retin A for redness and it is drying. This product removes dry skin gently leaving a glowing face.

This is my favorite facial cleanser. I use it daily. The packaging makes it easy to use and it's so effective. My skin feels so soft after I rinse it off. I will not allow myself to run out of this product. I keep an extra one as a backup.

I absolutely love the joystick exfoliating deep-pore cleanser! This product is travel-friendly and easy to use. I twist up the product and apply all over my face, massage the fine grains into my skin, and rinse off the excess after. It leaves me with a clean, soft feeling unlike other exfoliators I have tried that irritate my skin. I would highly recommend giving this product a try!

I really do love this product. I only wish it was either bigger for the price or a cheaper price. I use it daily sometimes twice a day and it really improves my skin but it only lasts me approximately 7 days maybe a little more.
What an amazing product! I have never bought a better deep cleanser than this one.

avis.titre: Clears up acne and leaves skin feeling soft and smooth. Love
avis.texte: Love that I can leave it on my skin for a few minutes for an even deeper clean!

It was okay. I personally have oily/dry combination skin. I honestly did what the instructions told me to do and used it while my skin was damp. Granted it wants to be focused on the T-zone and I want an all over exfoliator. I really didn't see much difference and I have used it for a few days. I mean it was gentle and left my skin clean but that was about it. I tried another exfoliator on a later date after giving Pur a chance and I noticed more from the other exfoliator in the results. I got a more clean feeling, I saw removal of dead skin with little massaging into the skin, and afterwards my skin got felt really soft!

I've finally found a product that does what I want!! My first time purchasing I was using this to remove makeup and cleanse but then I realized it would run out way too quickly. So now I use a facewash to remove makeup, then this to do a gentle cleansing scrub. I've repurchased 3x since my initial purchase. I've noticed Ulta has had PUR skincare 25% off quite a few times this year, so when it goes on sale I stock up. Smells like sunscreen, but in a good way. I love it!!

avis.titre: Good product but not enough of it
avis.texte: I really love this and the way it made my face feel like it had new skin on it every time I used it but the amount of product you get is not enough for the price you pay which is why I'm torn on whether I'll repurchase. I was actually shocked when I reached the bottom of the stick because it was gone so fast. If I repurchase I'll use it more sparingly and less often but it really is an awesome exfoliator that has been great for my dry acne-prone skin and I highly recommend it if it's in your budget.

Started using pur products a couple years ago and was so impressed. Each item has a purpose and does it well. This one is a roll on exfoliator. Roll it over whole face or just the problem area then add water to sort of bubble or fizz then rinse it all off. So easy!

I have combination skin and I have acne (no bad, but it's noticeable). I started using In The Clear by Pur, along with the Joystick and the Soak It Up Moisturizer. Literally, in two days i noticed an improvement in my skin. The Joystick is my favorite item in the group because after i use it my skin just instantly feels smoother. I usually use it just as an exfoliator in the morning, and a mask at night. I actually just now got my first bump in two weeks since is tarted using it and it's barely noticeable. I would totally buy it again.

I bought this from a funny blonde with short hair. She said this would help get rid of the dry skin. It worked! Finally a easy product that I can throw in my bag and travel with. I love how smooth my skin feels and looks after. I'm going to get one for my daughter this week.
